title: Battery passports and the EU DPP Registry: what the 30 October technical package means for your build
subtitle: The Commission has published a registration API, two authentication profiles and a battery data model for the EU DPP Registry. This is the work plan for battery makers ahead of 18 February 2027, and the reason a successful battery registration still needs testing.
excerpt: From 18 February 2027, EV, LMT and industrial batteries need a passport whose identifier reaches the EU DPP Registry. The Commission's technical package of 30 October 2026 brings an API, service-account and server-side authentication, and a semantic model for batteries. Here is what to build first.
